title: The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration…
description: A vulnerability in the UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration WordPress plugin before version 2.26.16.26 allows users with Subscriber role to plant serialized data that becomes a PHP Object Injection upon database backup and restore by an administrator. No known gadget chain exists to escalate this to code execution, and exploitation depends on precise alignment of planted data with the backup and restore process.
